dedupe_keys.name: instituto nacional de estatistica telecommunications datasets

description: Instituto Nacional de Estatística: telecommunications datasets is a collection of datasets listed in data.gov.pt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Instituto Nacional de Estatística. Coverage: Instituto Nacional de Estatística. The listing groups 52 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about telecommunications; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Proporção de empresas com 10 e mais pessoas ao serviço excluindo ativi; Proporção de indivíduos com idade entre 10 e 15 anos que utilizam tele; Proporção de indivíduos com idade entre 16 e 74 anos que dispõem de te; Proporção de empresas com 10 e mais pessoas ao serviço com ligação à I. Formats seen: JSON. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dados-gov-pt.
